006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
009
010import javax.xml.XMLConstants;
011
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
014
015/**
016 * Represents a model element that has a name and associated naming properties.
017 * <p>
018 * This interface provides methods for accessing the name, use name, qualified
019 * name, and index values used for XML and binary representations of model
020 * elements.
021 */
022public interface INamed {
023
024  /**
025   * Retrieve the name of the model element.
026   *
027   * @return the name
028   */
029  @NonNull
030  String getName();
031
032  /**
033   * Retrieve the name to use for the model element, instead of the name.
034   *
035   * @return the use name or {@code null} if no use name is defined
036   */
037  // from INamedModelElement
038  @Nullable
039  default String getUseName() {
040    // no use-name by default
041    return null;
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Get the name to use based on the provided names. This method will return the
046   * use name provided by {@link #getUseName()} if the call is not {@code null},
047   * and fall back to the name provided by {@link #getName()} otherwise. This is
048   * the model name to use for the for an instance where the instance is
049   * referenced.
050   *
051   * @return the use name if available, or the name if not
052   *
053   * @see #getUseName()
054   * @see #getName()
055   */
056  // from INamedModelElement
057  @NonNull
058  default String getEffectiveName() {
059    @Nullable
060    String useName = getUseName();
061    return useName == null ? getName() : useName;
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Get the unique XML qualified name for this model element.
066   * <p>
067   * The qualified name is considered to be unique relative to all sibling
068   * elements. For a flag, this name will be unique among all flag instances on
069   * the same field or assembly definition. For a field or assembly, this name
070   * will be unique among all sibling field or assembly instances on the same
071   * assembly definition.
072   * <p>
073   * Multiple calls to this method are expected to produce the same, deterministic
074   * return value.
075   * <p>
076   * If the namespace is not specified, then the resulting QName will have the
077   * namespace {@link XMLConstants#NULL_NS_URI}.
078   * <p>
079   * This implementation may be overridden by implementation that cache the QName
080   * or provide for a more efficient method for QName creation.
081   *
082   * @return the XML qualified name, or {@code null} if there isn't one
083   */
084  @NonNull
085  IEnhancedQName getQName();
086
087  /**
088   * Retrieve the index value to use for binary naming.
089   *
090   * @return the name index or {@code null} if no name index is defined
091   */
092  // from INamedModelElement
093  @Nullable
094  default Integer getIndex() {
095    // no index by default
096    return null;
097  }
098
099  /**
100   * Retrieve the index value to use for binary naming, instead of the name.
101   *
102   * @return the use name index or {@code null} if no use name index is defined
103   */
104  // from INamedModelElement
105  @Nullable
106  default Integer getUseIndex() {
107    // no use-name index by default
108    return null;
109  }
110
111  /**
112   * Get the index value to use for binary naming based on the provided index
113   * values.
114   * <p>
115   * This method will return the use index value provided by
116   * {@link #getUseIndex()} if the call result is not {@code null}, and fall back
117   * to the index value provided by {@link #getIndex()} otherwise.
118   *
119   * @return the index value if available, or {@code null} otherwise
120   */
121  // from INamedModelElement
122  @Nullable
123  default Integer getEffectiveIndex() {
124    @Nullable
125    Integer useIndex = getUseIndex();
126    return useIndex == null ? getIndex() : useIndex;
127  }
128}
